mentions.name: Million Dollar Chat
mentions.description: This app is a free-to-use web chatbot that reimagines the million dollar homepage for the AI age. Anyone can influence the chatbot by adding to its context, and the chatbot's "thoughts" are streamed to all visitors. It is framed as a fun novelty rather than a practical tool.
